description: Subscribe a company to ongoing monitoring. Status changes, dissolutions, sanctions matches and corporate events (ES, FR (BODACC notices), GB, IE/PL/NO (the last three from 14 Oct 2026) and FI/SE/BE/HR/DK/EE/SK/CH/LV/CY/RO/LT/CA/AU/JP/IL/SG/CO/TW/BR/CZ/DE/IT/IN/AT/CN/VG/LU/KY/HU/PT/JE/LI/AE/GG/TR/PA/SA/IS/BS/MU/IM/BM/ZA/GR/LU/HU/PT/JE/MX/NL/AR/UA/RS/SI/MT/EC/IT/IN/AT/GR/LU/HU/PT/US) are checked every 30 minutes from 05:00 to 22:30 UTC and POSTed to your webhook_url (HMAC-SHA256 signed). Returns the monitor ID and a webhook_secret (shown once). Available for Spain (ES), France (FR), the United Kingdom (GB), Ireland (IE), Poland (PL), Norway (NO), Finland (FI), Sweden (SE), Belgium (BE), Croatia (HR), Denmark (DK), Estonia (e-Business Register), Slovakia (RPO), Switzerland (Zefix), Latvia (Register of Enterprises), Cyprus (DRCOR), Romania (ONRC), Lithuania (JAR), Canada (federal corporations), Australia (ASIC and ABR), Japan (NTA), Israel (Corporations Authority), Singapore (ACRA), Colombia (RUES), Taiwan (GCIS), Brazil (CNPJ), Argentina (RNS, read monthly: no events before 28 Oct 2026, and dissolution alert only for companies whose status the IGJ gives), the Czech Republic, Germany (LEI-registered entities and energy-market register companies, sanctions matches only for the latter), the Netherlands (LEI-registered entities with a KVK number), Mexico (LEI-registered entities; a company only INEGI's DENUE directory lists raises sanctions matches only), Ukraine, Serbia, Slovenia, Malta, Ecuador, Greece, Moldova and every LEI layer (more than 20 jurisdictions, including Austria, Italy, India, Luxembourg and China), that is every live country except Chile, South Korea, New Caledonia, Peru, Honduras, Guatemala, Uruguay, the Dominican Republic, New Zealand, Bulgaria, Georgia, Tanzania, Zambia and Paraguay. A dissolution alert fires on the dissolution date the register gives or, where the register gives none (Canada, Israel, Singapore, Taiwan, Romania, many US registrations), when the status first shows closed (detail.date_basis first_seen_closed, else register). Two more alert types, contract_awarded and grant_received, are opt-in and sent only when listed in events: contract_awarded is a public-contract award newly published with the company as supplier (the monitored countries of procurement_awards: not Chile), dated by the award date the buyer published, else the day it was first seen (detail.date_basis award_date or first_seen), with buyer, amount awarded (not a payment), currency and source; France: a closure alert only when a company not seen closed becomes closed (dated by the register, which can be months old); a company that withheld its name is monitored by SIREN, unnamed and not screened against sanctions lists; no financial-flag alert. Spanish contracts published only on a regional platform (Catalonia, the Basque Country, Navarre, Madrid, Andalusia, Galicia, La Rioja) are not covered. grant_received is a public grant newly published for the company (Spain only, legal entities, concessions from 26 Sep 2026), dated by the concession date; a grant registered late is alerted late, and a grant is never a risk. Sanctions matches: the company's register name is screened against the sanctions lists when monitoring starts, again when its register name changes, and against each listing a list adds or changes. An alert fires only at a match_score of 80 or more on the sanctions screen scale (100: a listed name or alias is the company's name; 80-99: a listed name starts with the company's name, or ends with it after a few leading words such as "Banco"); one alert per monitor, after which the company is not screened again. detail carries match_score, matched_name, matched_on (name or alias), entity_name, entity_id, source_list and trigger (company_screen or list_change). Sanctions screening is beta: a match is a prompt to look, not a finding. This creates a persistent subscription, active until it is stopped with monitor_stop.

company_id.description: Prometiam internal company ID to monitor (from companies_search / company_detail).

country.description: Country of the company to monitor: ES (default), FR, GB, IE, PL, NO, FI, SE, BE, HR, DK, EE, SK, CH, LV, CY, RO, LT, CA, AU, JP, IL, SG, CO, TW, BR, CZ, DE, IT, IN, AT, CN, VG, LU, KY, HU, PT, JE, LI, AE, GG, TR, PA, SA, IS, BS, MU, IM, BM, ZA, GR, LU, HU, PT, JE, MX, NL, AR, UA, RS, MT, SI, EC, MD, IT, IN, AT, GR, LU, HU, PT or US. Monitoring is not available for CL, KR, NC, PE, HN, GT, UY, DO, NZ, BG, GE, TZ, ZM or PY.

events.description: Optional list of event types to filter alerts to (default: all applicable: corporate_event, status_change, dissolution, sanctions_match). Also available on request, never by default: lei_lapsed, an alert when the LEI of the company goes from a renewed status to LAPSED while you watch it (detail: lei, from, to, next_renewal, days_since_renewal_due). A lapse is an unpaid or unconfirmed LEI renewal, not a sign of distress. Only for a company with an LEI link; a company whose LEI is already lapsed when you subscribe does not alert for it. Also on request, never by default: financial_flag (Scale plan and above; GB, RO, SE, NO, DK, EE, LV, LT and FI), an alert when a warning flag of the latest annual accounts turns on (detail: flags, active_flags, fiscal_year, period_end, statement_type, filing_date); a flag already on when you subscribe does not alert. An indicator read from accounts that can be up to three years old, never a rating. Also on request, never by default: contract_awarded and grant_received (a public-contract award or a public grant newly published for the company; the limits are in the description of this tool); they are never sent unless listed here. Re-sending a company with events changes what it receives.

label.description: Optional human-friendly label for this subscription.

webhook_url.description: HTTPS URL that receives signed alert POSTs.

name: monitor_subscribe
title: Monitor a company
